parameters.query: UPDATE leads SET score = {{ $json.score }}, score_label = '{{ $json.label }}', score_details = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.breakdown) }}', status = 'qualified', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

UPDATE leads SET score = {{ $json.score }}, score_label = '{{ $json.label }}', score_details = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.breakdown) }}', status = CASE WHEN {{ $json.score }} >= 40 THEN 'qualified' ELSE 'new' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
